definitions.gloss: joint and several obligation; joint and several debt
definitions.explanation: A debt owed by two or more people in which each of them is liable for the whole amount, so the creditor may demand full payment from any one of them.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{連帯債務|れんたいさいむ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{負|お}う→負う：02017_ou⟧。
examples.english: A married couple take on a joint and several debt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧⟦ローン→ローン：06579_roon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{連帯債務|れんたいさいむ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{組|く}んだ→組む：02050_kumu⟧。
examples.english: We took out the home loan as joint and several debtors.

examples.english: With a joint and several obligation, the bank can demand repayment of the full amount from either borrower.

notes:
USAGE:
Most often met in home loans taken out by a couple (ペアローン is the other common arrangement, with two separate loans). A person who owes it is a {連帯債務者|れんたいさいむしゃ}.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {連帯保証|れんたいほしょう}: joint and several guarantee. A ⟦{連帯保証人|れんたいほしょうにん}→連帯保証人：09813_rentaihoshounin⟧ backs someone else's debt; in {連帯債務|れんたいさいむ} each person is a borrower in their own right.
- ⟦{債務|さいむ}→債務：06578_saimu⟧: debt, obligation (general word)
